column1: a Abbreviations are AMP: ampicillin, CHL: chloramphenicol, CIP: ciprofloxacin, ERY: erythromycin, GEN: gentamicin, SPC: spectinomycin, STR: streptomycin, TET: tetracycline, VAN: vancomycin.

b The minimal inhibitory concentration (MIC) of the indicated antibiotics against the seven isolates was determined by broth microdilution. The results are the averages of three independent determinations. Breakpoints for antimicrobial resistance are as follows: ampicillin, minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) ≥ 16 μg/ml; chloramphenicol, MIC ≥ 32 μg/ml; ciprofloxacin, MIC ≥ 4 μg/ml; erythromycin, MIC ≥ 8 μg/ml; gentamicin, MIC ≥ 128 μg/ml; spectinomycin, MIC ≥ 256 μg/ml; streptomycin, MIC ≥ 256 μg/ml; tetracycline ≥ 8 μg/ml; vancomycin ≥ 4 μg/ml.
c None of the previously charachterized erythromycin resistance genes ermA, ermB, mefA or msrA are present in E980.
